source: *snores*
translation: *打鼾*

source: *snores*
translation: *打鼾*

source: {i}(Ah… Sir Goro’s still asleep…){/i}
translation: {i}（啊……Goro先生还在睡……）{/i}

source: {i}(He’s so warm and relaxed… I can feel his chest rising softly against my cheek…){/i}
translation: {i}（他身上好温暖，整个人也很放松……我能感觉到他的胸膛在我的脸颊旁轻柔地起伏……）{/i}

source: {i}(It looks like he’s completely calmed down too… I thought he wouldn’t be able to sleep after what happened last night…){/i}
translation: {i}（看起来他也完全平静下来了……我还以为昨晚发生那件事后，他会无法入睡……）{/i}

source: {i}(I hope I can always comfort him like this…){/i}
translation: {i}（希望我能永远这样安慰他……）{/i}

source: Ah, Sir Goro…! S-Sorry, did I wake you?
translation: 啊，Goro先生……！对、对不起，是我吵醒你了吗？

source: You’re fine… I wouldn’t mind waking up to this every day, anyway…
translation: 你没事……不过，我倒不介意每天都这样醒来……

source: {i}(Sir Goro pulled me tighter into his body with his strong manly arms...){/i}
translation: {i}（Goro先生用强壮的手臂把我更紧地搂进怀里……）{/i}

source: {i}(Waking up in the morning and hugging someone special like this made me realize I'd never been so intimate with someone before...){/i}
translation: {i}（早上醒来后这样拥抱特别的人，让我意识到自己以前从未和谁如此亲密过……）{/i}

source: {i}(To think that it's with Sir Goro as well... I never thought this day would come.){/i}
translation: {i}（而且对象还是Goro先生……我从没想过这一天会到来。）{/i}

source: Yes, sir?
translation: 是的，先生？

source: About last night…
translation: 关于昨晚……

source: I’m sorry again you had to see me like that…
translation: 对不起，又让你看到我那副样子……

source: No, sir… There’s nothing you need to apologize for…
translation: 不，先生……你没什么需要道歉的……

source: This has been weighing on you for a long time and you were pushed to your limit…
translation: 这件事已经压在你心里很久了，而你也被逼到了极限……

source: None of us would’ve been able to endure that for as long as you have, sir…
translation: 我们任何人都不可能像你一样忍受那么久，先生……

source: I’m just… not used to showing vulnerability like that.
translation: 我只是……不习惯那样表现自己的脆弱。

source: Especially to you…
translation: 尤其是在你面前……

source: But it only made me respect you even more, sir.
translation: 但这只让我更加尊敬你，先生。

source: For the longest time, you were someone all of us could count on no matter how tough things were…  always handling everything by yourself.
translation: 长久以来，无论事情多艰难，你都是我们所有人可以依靠的人……总是独自处理一切。

source: It takes courage to tear your walls down, and allow someone to see how you truly feel inside…
translation: 需要勇气打破自己的壁垒，让别人看到你内心真正的感受……

source: Knowing that you trust me enough to let me into your darkest thoughts... It really means a lot to me, sir.
translation: 知道你足够信任我，愿意让我进入你最黑暗的思绪……这对我来说意义重大，先生。

source: I really do trust you, Yoshinori… Thanks for helping me get through it…
translation: 我真的信任你，Yoshinori……谢谢你帮我熬过这一切……

source: I never thought I’d get another chance to open up to you like that and let everything out…
translation: 我没想过自己还能有机会像那样向你敞开心扉，把一切都释放出来……

source: I feel like you’ve helped me get rid of a huge weight off my chest… and for that I’m grateful.
translation: 我感觉你帮我卸下了胸口的一块巨石……为此我很感激。

source: I’m glad you can count on me too, sir… We’re partners, after all.
translation: 我也很高兴你能依靠我，先生……毕竟我们是伙伴。

source: And… about that… I really meant what I said last night…
translation: 还有……关于那件事……我昨晚说的话都是真心的……

source: It’s taken a long time for me to realize that what I felt for you has turned into something more…
translation: 我花了很长时间才意识到，我对你的感情已经变成了更深的东西……

source: In the past, I never thought I’d see you this way.
translation: 过去，我从没想过会这样看你。

source: But when you left... I suddenly began to feel empty…
translation: 但你离开后……我突然感到内心空荡荡的……

source: And when we were reunited, I wanted things to go back to the way they were, but everything was already different.
translation: 当我们重逢时，我想让一切回到原来的样子，可一切已经不同了。

source: Time had set us apart, and I believed there was no way we could return to what we had before.
translation: 时间让我们分开，我以为我们再也无法回到从前。

source: Because of that, I kept those feelings locked away...
translation: 因为这样，我一直把那些感情锁在心里……

source: I felt the same way too, Sir Goro…
translation: 我当时也有同样的感觉，Goro先生……

source: Even back then, I already knew my feelings for you went way beyond admiration.
translation: 其实那时我就知道，我对你的感情远远超出了仰慕。

source: But… we were in such different times of our lives, so I knew I couldn’t pursue it.
translation: 但是……我们处在人生中完全不同的阶段，所以我知道自己不能追求这份感情。

source: After that, I closed off my feelings, just like you…
translation: 从那以后，我也像你一样封闭了自己的感情……

source: I-I guess what I’m trying to say is that…
translation: 我、我想说的是……

source: I’ve always loved you, sir…
translation: 我一直爱着你，先生……

source: I love you too, Yoshinori…
translation: 我也爱你，Yoshinori……

source: {i}(Our lips touched once again, but compared to last night I felt nothing but happiness and a sense of relief that Sir Goro felt the same way I did.){/i}
translation: {i}（我们的嘴唇再次触碰，但和昨晚相比，我感受到的只有幸福，以及Goro先生和我有着同样感情的释然。）{/i}

source: It’s almost cruel, isn’t it…?
translation: 这几乎有些残酷，不是吗……？

source: But then… maybe it took so long for a good reason…
translation: 但话说回来……也许这件事花了这么久才发生，是有原因的……

source: You’re right, sir… I can’t imagine we’d have been able to reach this point without going through everything we have the past few years together.
translation: 你说得对，先生……我无法想象，如果过去几年我们没有一起经历这一切，我们还能走到今天。

source: Even still, there was always a connection between us… and we certainly did some things that normally belong to couples.
translation: 即使如此，我们之间一直有着联系……而且我们确实做过一些通常只有情侣才会做的事。

source: Now we get to experience what it’s like to actually be one…
translation: 现在我们终于可以体验真正成为情侣是什么感觉了……

source: It feels so surreal hearing that from you, sir…
translation: 听你这样说，先生……感觉太不真实了……

source: On that note… I’d really prefer it if you dropped the formality and called me by name from now on.
translation: 说到这个……我真的希望你以后别再用那么正式的称呼，直接叫我的名字。

source: Ack… That’s going to be tough… I’ve gotten so used to calling you ‘Sir’ over the years… It’s almost like it’s part of your name too, haha.
translation: 啊……这会很难……这么多年来我已经习惯称你为“先生”……它几乎也成了你名字的一部分，哈哈。

source: Well, it’s not going to change unless you start… After all, we’re equals, aren’t we?
translation: 只要你开始叫，就会慢慢改变的……毕竟，我们是平等的，对吧？

source: Y-Yes, but that doesn’t mean I’ll stop looking up to you, sir— I mean… Goro…
translation: 是、是的，但这不代表我会停止仰望你，先生——我的意思是……Goro……

source: Heh, I don’t mind that you do, but I’d still like you to try and see me differently.
translation: 呵，我不介意你仰望我，但我还是希望你试着用不同的方式看我。

source: C-Can I ask why…?
translation: 我、我能问问为什么吗……？

source: Hmmm… I suppose it makes me feel closer to you and more… intimate.
translation: 嗯……我想，这让我觉得和你更亲近，也更……亲密。

source: Hmmm… I suppose it makes me feel closer to you and more… intimate.{fast}
translation: 嗯……我想，这让我觉得和你更亲近，也更……亲密。{fast}

source: Yes, sir...
translation: 是的，先生……

source: Yes, sir… I mean… Goro…!
translation: 是的，先生……我的意思是……Goro……！

source: I'll try my best then...
translation: 我会尽力试试……

source: It’s going to take some time getting used to, but I’ll try… Goro…
translation: 习惯起来需要一些时间，但我会试试……Goro……

source: Alright, then...
translation: 好吧……

source: Alright then… from now on, I’ll call you Goro…
translation: 那么好……从现在开始，我会叫你Goro……

source: Goro...
translation: Goro……

source: *hugs Yoshinori tightly*
translation: *紧紧抱住Yoshinori*

source: I really wish I could stay like this with you forever…
translation: 我真希望能永远这样和你待在一起……

source: {i}(I feel like I’m seeing a whole different part of Goro for the first time… I never realized how romantic he could be…){/i}
translation: {i}（我感觉自己第一次看到了Goro完全不同的一面……我从没意识到他可以这么浪漫……）{/i}

source: To think that we’ll have to leave soon and go back to reality…
translation: 想到我们很快就要离开，回到现实……

source: This vacation has passed by so quickly… I didn’t even realize that we were going home today.
translation: 这次假期过得太快了……我甚至没意识到今天就要回家。

source: And I have to try and fix everything that happened at the restaurant last night… *sigh*
translation: 我还得想办法解决昨晚餐厅发生的一切……*叹气*

source: Don’t think about that now… We still have the morning to enjoy together…
translation: 现在别想那些……我们还有整个上午可以一起享受……

source: Hehe… I can always count on you to take my mind off of things… it just makes me want to cuddle with you more…
translation: 嘿嘿……我总能指望你让我忘掉烦恼……这只会让我更想和你依偎……

source: *hugs Yoshinori tighter*
translation: *把Yoshinori抱得更紧*

source: Nngk...! I-I think you’re squeezing too tightly, sir…!
translation: 嗯嘎……！我、我觉得你抱得太紧了，先生……！

source: Hmm? Who’s this ‘sir’ you’re calling for help~?
translation: 嗯？你叫的这个“先生”是谁，想让他来救你吗~？

source: G-Goro…!
translation: 吾、Goro……！

source: Hehehe… That’s what I thought~
translation: 嘿嘿嘿……我就知道你会这么说~

source: *sigh* You’re way too strong…
translation: *叹气* 你力气太大了……

source: Don’t play coy, Yoshinori. I already know you love that part about me.
translation: 别装害羞，Yoshinori。我已经知道你喜欢我这一点了。

source: Besides, didn’t you say you wanted to ‘enjoy’ the morning together?
translation: 再说，你不是说想“一起享受”这个上午吗？

source: Goro…!
translation: Goro……！

source: {i}(I could feel myself heating up against his thigh, trying to resist the temptation for some reason.){/i}
translation: {i}（我能感觉到自己的身体贴着他的腿发热，不知为何还在努力抵抗诱惑。）{/i}

source: What’s the matter, Yoshinori? I thought we were done holding back?
translation: 怎么了，Yoshinori？我以为我们已经不再克制了？

source: Go ahead, I’ll let you make the first move…
translation: 来吧，我让你先主动……

source: You’d better make the most of it – you won’t be able to resist when it’s my turn…
translation: 你最好好好利用这个机会——轮到我时，你就无法抵抗了……

source: Hah…
Get down there already, Yoshinori…
translation: 已经到下面来吧，Yoshinori……

source: {i}(Sir Goro took over and stuck his tongue out, entwining it with mine.){/i}
translation: {i}（Goro先生接过主动权，伸出舌头与我的舌头交缠。）{/i}

source: Hah, that’s what I thought~
translation: 呵，我就知道你会这么做~

source: Hehe…
translation: 嘿嘿……

source: {i}(The pleasure in Goro’s voice sent shivers throughout my body, and all I wanted was to give in and make the most of this moment…){/i}
translation: {i}（Goro声音中的愉悦让我浑身战栗，我只想彻底放纵，好好享受这一刻……）{/i}

source: {i}Still filled with passion, we finished up with a tender kiss…{/i}
translation: {i}我们依然沉浸在激情中，以一个温柔的吻结束了这一切……{/i}

source: {i}I would never forget this moment with Goro…{/i}
translation: {i}我永远不会忘记和Goro共度的这一刻……{/i}

source: Nghh… S-Sorry I can’t help pack, Goro…
translation: 呜……对、对不起，我没法帮忙收拾行李，Goro……

source: It’s fine. Leave the packing to me.
translation: 没关系。收拾行李交给我。

source: You’re still sore from all that pounding, hehe~
translation: 你还在为刚才那一番折腾感到酸痛，嘿嘿~

source: Y-Your size isn’t something anyone can get used to easily…
translation: 你、你的尺寸不是谁都能轻易习惯的……

source: Trust me, you will. Just give it a couple more rounds.
translation: 相信我，你会的。再来几轮就好了。

source: Not right now… I could barely put my underwear on…
translation: 现在不要……我几乎连内裤都穿不上……

source: I think that should be everything…
translation: 我想应该就这些了……

source: Thanks for helping me pack, Yoshinori. I almost always leave something behind on trips like these…
translation: 谢谢你帮我收拾行李，Yoshinori。像这样的旅行，我几乎总会忘带东西……

source: Ahehe, Yuri specifically asked me to make sure you had everything…
translation: 啊哈哈，Yuri特意让我确保你什么都带齐……

source: Heh, so much for being a prepared scoutmaster, right?
translation: 呵，还说自己是准备周全的童军团长呢，对吧？

source: *sigh* I know I mentioned this before, but… I’m a bit disappointed we’re headed home today.
translation: *叹气* 我知道我之前提过，但……我有点不想今天就回家。

source: It’s been so nice to spend time with you privately, and now we’re headed back to share a room with everyone again.
translation: 能和你私下相处真好，现在却要回去和大家一起住一个房间了。

source: And that’s not even including how busy we’ll be.
translation: 还不包括我们之后会有多忙。

source: Haha, it’s alright! We’re gonna go on more trips like this in the future, I’m sure!
translation: 哈哈，没关系！以后我们肯定还会这样一起旅行的！

source: Heh, you seem pretty confident about that.
translation: 呵，你对这件事还真有信心。

source: W-Well, we are dating now, after all… Although I admit it’s still hard to wrap my head around being with my boss…
translation: 嗯、嗯，我们毕竟现在在约会……不过我得承认，和我的老板交往这件事我还是很难接受……

source: *sigh* For some reason, I felt like you were going to say something like that…
translation: *叹气* 不知为什么，我就觉得你会说这种话……

source: O-Oh!
translation: 哦、哦！

source: Coming. Just a sec!
translation: 来了。等一下！

source: Here, Yoshinori. Get dressed.
translation: 来，Yoshinori。穿好衣服。

source: R-Right…!
Good morning, guys! I knew you’d be awake at this time, Dad.
translation: 早上好，大家！爸爸，我就知道你这个时候会醒。

source: Come in, take a seat.
translation: 进来，坐吧。

source: What brings you here, dear?
translation: 亲爱的，你来这里做什么？

source: Well… I just wanted to check up on both of you, especially you, Dad…!
translation: 嗯……我只是想来看看你们两个，尤其是你，爸爸……！

source: I mean… after what happened last night…
translation: 我的意思是……昨晚发生了那件事……

source: I’m fine, dear. Thanks for checking up on me.
translation: 我没事，亲爱的。谢谢你来看我。

source: Phew… Thank goodness, I was really worried after you got so upset…
translation: 呼……谢天谢地，你刚才那么激动，我真的很担心……

source: Well, thankfully, Yoshinori was able to calm me down.
translation: 幸好Yoshinori能让我冷静下来。

source: That’s good… I knew Yoshi would be able to take care of you, that’s why I left you guys alone last night.
translation: 太好了……我就知道Yoshi能照顾好你，所以昨晚才让你们单独待着。

source: About that… I’m really sorry for walking out on you all so abruptly…
translation: 关于这件事……突然丢下你们离开，我真的很抱歉……

source: It’s fine, Dad. We all saw what happened there, and it was really Emilia that crossed the line.
translation: 没关系，爸爸。我们都看到了现场发生的事，真正越界的是Emilia。

source: Honestly, if you hadn’t stepped up like that, I would’ve slapped her stupid face myself…
translation: 老实说，如果不是你那样站出来，我自己就会扇她那张蠢脸……

source: Ah, right… I did leave quite a mess back at the dinner… I’ll have to talk to the manager and formally apologize.
translation: 啊，对了……我确实把晚餐现场弄得一团糟……我得和经理谈谈，正式道歉。

source: Oh, you don’t need to worry about that, Dad! We already handled it last night!
translation: 哦，你不用担心那个，爸爸！我们昨晚已经处理好了！

source: Thankfully, the manager was pretty understanding of the situation!
translation: 幸好经理很理解当时的情况！

source: Whew… That’s a relief…
translation: 呼……真是松了一口气……

source: So yeah, that’s one less thing to worry about!
translation: 所以，至少又少了一件需要担心的事！

source: Thank you for taking care of that, Yuri… I was really worried it put us in serious trouble.
translation: 谢谢你处理了那个，Yuri……我真的担心这会让我们惹上大麻烦。

source: Of course, Dad! We’ve all got your back!
translation: 当然，爸爸！我们都会支持你！

source: Anyway, I think it’s almost check-out time. Have you packed yet, dear?
translation: 总之，我觉得差不多到退房时间了。你收拾好了吗，亲爱的？

source: Oh no, I haven’t yet! I came here as soon as I woke up!
translation: 哦，不，我还没有！我一醒来就赶过来了！

source: It’s alright, I’m glad you did. You can go finish up, but make sure and dress warmly.
translation: 没关系，我很高兴你来了。你可以去收拾，但记得穿暖和些。

source: It looks quite cold out there…
translation: 外面看起来很冷……

source: Alright, Dad. I’ll go check up on everyone else too and make sure they’re ready.
translation: 好的，爸爸。我也去看看其他人，确保他们都准备好了。

source: Thanks, dear. Let’s just meet downstairs at the lobby.
translation: 谢谢，亲爱的。我们楼下大厅见吧。

source: Okay, Dad! See you both there!
translation: 好的，爸爸！到时候见！

source: Wh-Whoa… There’s a huge crowd in here!
translation: 哇、哇……这里人也太多了！

source: Did something happen…?
translation: 发生什么事了……？

source: Look at the entrance, Yoshinori.
translation: 看看入口，Yoshinori。

source: It’s covered in snow! I didn’t even notice that it stormed last night…
translation: 被雪覆盖了！我甚至没注意到昨晚下了暴雪……

source: Me either… The sky was even clear this morning from the view in our room.
translation: 我也是……从我们房间看出去，今天早上的天空甚至还很晴朗。

source: Hey, guys! Good morn—
translation: 嘿，大家！早——

source: Whoa! What’s with the commotion?
translation: 哇！这是怎么回事，怎么这么吵？

source: *sigh* I knew this would happen… I got woken up last night as soon as it hit.
translation: *叹气* 我就知道会这样……昨晚雪一落下我就被吵醒了。

source: I didn’t think it’d be this bad.
translation: 我没想到会这么严重。

source: Uh-oh, I don’t think I’ve ever seen this much snow before!
translation: 糟糕，我以前好像从没见过这么大的雪！

source: Does this mean we can’t go home…?
translation: 这是不是意味着我们回不了家了……？

source: Unfortunately, that might be the case…
translation: 遗憾的是，可能是这样……

source: But look over there! She’s harassing that poor bellboy!
translation: 但看那边！她正在骚扰那个可怜的侍者！

source: After what she did last night, we might actually get kicked out… I don’t wanna spend tonight covered in snow…
translation: 按她昨晚的所作所为，我们可能真的会被赶出去……我可不想今晚睡在雪里……

source: Sh-Should someone try and stop her…?
translation: 有、有人要不要试着阻止她……？

source: Sh-Should someone try and stop her…? {fast}
translation: 有、有人要不要试着阻止她……？{fast}

source: Let Emilia be.
translation: 别管Emilia。

source: Just let her be, guys. She might just get angrier.
translation: 大家就让她去吧。她可能只会变得更生气。

source: B-But still…
translation: 但、但是……

source: Jin’s right. We can’t let her disrespect the staff anymore than she has already.
translation: Jin说得对。我们不能再任由她像之前那样侮辱员工。

source: I’ll handle it.
translation: 我来处理。

source: I'll handle it.
translation: 我来处理。

source: I’ll handle her, guys. Let me go and sort this out.
translation: 我来对付她，大家。让我去把这事解决。

source: No, Yoshinori, I’ll do it.
translation: 不，Yoshinori，我来。

source: Mr. Clermont put my name as the head of our party, so it’s best if I resolve the situation myself.
translation: Clermont先生把我的名字列为我们这群人的负责人，所以最好由我亲自解决。

source: We need to know the situation too.
translation: 我们也需要了解情况。

source: That might be a good idea… We need to know what’s going on too.
translation: 这主意不错……我们也需要知道发生了什么。

source: And her disrespecting the staff isn’t going to get us any answers…
translation: 她继续侮辱员工也不会让我们得到任何答案……

source: You’re both right.  I’ll go and see what’s going on.
translation: 你们说得对。我要去看看发生了什么。

source: Let Goro handle it.
translation: 让Goro处理吧。

source: Hmm… I guess we should.
translation: 嗯……我想我们应该去。

source: Let me handle this.
translation: 让我来处理。

source: We need to know the situation, after all.
translation: 毕竟，我们需要了解情况。

source: A-Are you sure that’s a good idea, Dad? She might…
translation: 爸、爸爸，你确定这是好主意吗？她可能……

source: It’ll be fine, Yuri. Trust me, I know what to do this time.
translation: 没事，Yuri。相信我，这次我知道该怎么做。

source: You can’t talk to a VIP guest like this!
translation: 你不能这样和 VIP 客人说话！

source: Just you wait until the owner of this establishment gets the letter I’ll be writing! I’ll make sure all the incompetent staff like you are fired!
translation: 你等着吧，等这家店的老板收到我要写的信！我会确保像你这样的无能员工全都被解雇！

source: *ehem* Ms. Komarova?
translation: *呃咳* Komarova女士？

source: Let me take it from here.
translation: 接下来交给我。

source: Good morning. Firstly, I’d like to apologize on the behalf of Mr. Clermont’s party.
translation: 早上好。首先，我想代表Clermont先生一行向您道歉。

source: I understand we’re in a bit of a situation here?
translation: 我明白我们现在遇到了一点状况？

source: Unfortunately, yes. A strong blizzard blew through the capital last night and rendered all the roads unpassable.
translation: 很遗憾，是的。昨晚一场强烈的暴风雪席卷首都，导致所有道路无法通行。

source: Consequently, all shuttles have been cancelled due to these conditions.
translation: 因此，由于天气状况，所有接驳车都取消了。

source: But the good news is, the storm has already passed, and the clean-up operations are already underway.
translation: 但好消息是，暴风雪已经过去，清理工作也已经开始了。

source: Understood. Thank you for the update. That means we’ll have to extend our stay here, doesn’t it?
translation: 明白了。谢谢你告知情况。这意味着我们得延长在这里的住宿，对吧？

source: Yes, and Mr. Clermont has already been made aware of the situation and has arranged extended accommodations for your party.
translation: 是的，Clermont先生已经得知情况，并为你们一行安排了延长住宿。

source: Please continue to enjoy the facilities, and we’ll contact you as soon as the roads are cleared out!
translation: 请继续享用这里的设施，道路清理完毕后我们会第一时间联系您！

source: Ah, thank you very much. That should be everything we need.
translation: 啊，非常感谢。这应该就是我们需要知道的全部了。

source: Can you kindly escort her to her room, please?
translation: 能请你把她送回房间吗？

source: I was expecting she’d throw a fit at me for interrupting, considering our debacle last night.
translation: 考虑到我们昨晚的闹剧，我本以为她会因为我打断她而大发脾气。

source: But I guess she thought I was on her side, and that was enough to shut her down.
translation: 不过我想她以为我站在她那边，这就足以让她闭嘴了。

source: She was reaaaallly glaring at you though, Gramps.
translation: 不过，她刚才真的一直瞪着你，Gramps。

source: Well, let’s forget about her and figure out what we can still do around here for the day!
translation: 好了，别管她了，想想我们今天还能在这里做些什么吧！

source: Right… We aren’t even sure how long we’ll be stuck.
translation: 对……我们甚至不知道还要被困多久。

source: Yeah… It’s probably gonna take a while to get rid of all that snow…
translation: 是啊……清理那么多雪可能要花一段时间……

source: It has been snowing ever since we got here.
translation: 从我们到这里起就一直在下雪。

source: Really…? Wow… I didn’t notice at all.
translation: 真的吗……？哇……我完全没注意。

source: Me neither… We were so busy pampering ourselves that we forgot what was happening in the outside world.
translation: 我也是……我们忙着享受奢侈生活，忘了外面的世界发生了什么。

source: But hey, I’m not complaining! I won’t say no to more fancy living!
translation: 不过嘿，我可没有抱怨！再享受几天奢华生活我也不会拒绝！

source: You’ve barely left the room the last two days, Jin.
translation: Jin，这两天你几乎都没离开过房间。

source: I could use a coffee… I haven’t had one today because I was rush packing.
translation: 我想喝杯咖啡……因为急着收拾行李，我今天还没喝过。

source: Yeah, I’m hungry toooo… I didn’t really eat much last night…
translation: 是啊，我也好饿……昨晚没怎么吃东西……

source: Let’s go then.
translation: 那就走吧。

source: I guess what we talked about this morning came true, huh?
translation: 我想我们今天早上谈到的事成真了，对吧？

source: Hehe… I was thinking the same thing, Yoshinori.
translation: 嘿嘿……我也在想同样的事，Yoshinori。

source: Although, as much as I’d like to stay here longer, hearing what Emilia said about our project has me concerned as well.
translation: 不过，虽然我很想在这里多待一阵子，听到Emilia说的那些关于项目的话，也让我很担心。

source: There’s not much we can do until the snow is gone, though…
translation: 不过在雪停之前，我们也没什么能做的……

source: That’s right. I guess let’s make the most out of it while we’re still here.
translation: 没错。我想我们应该趁还在这里，尽量把时间过得充实。

source: Yeah! That’s a good way to put it!
translation: 对！这样说就对了！

source: Hey, are you guys coming?
translation: 嘿，你们来不来？

source: Ah, yes, dear!
translation: 啊，是的，亲爱的！

source: We haven’t really had time to do any activities as a group, you know?
translation: 我们好像一直没有时间作为一个团队一起参加活动，你知道吧？

source: Well, the one chance we had to do that was last night.
translation: 我们唯一有机会这么做的时候，就是昨晚。

source: We all know how that went…
translation: 大家都知道结果如何……

source: Speaking of last night though… and I don’t mean to dig into it more, but…
translation: 说到昨晚……我不是想继续深挖，但……

source: Are you feelin’ alright, Gramps...?
translation: Gramps，你感觉还好吗……？

source: I mean… I’m glad you seem okay this morning, but I dunno if you were just tryna keep up appearances…
translation: 我的意思是……我很高兴你今天早上看起来没事，但我不知道你是不是只是在强装镇定……

source: Yeah… We didn’t really get the chance to ask you…
translation: 是啊……我们确实一直没机会问你……

source: I-I had so much anxiety thinking about what Emilia had done to you…
translation: 想​​到Emilia对你做的事，我、我真的非常焦虑……

source: We were worried about you, sir.
translation: 我们很担心你，先生。

source: I’m fine now, everyone… I didn’t mean to make you all worry…
translation: 我现在没事了，大家……我不是想让你们担心……

source: If I had controlled myself better, then none of that would’ve happened.
translation: 如果我能更好地控制自己，那些事就不会发生。

source: So, I really apologize for my behavior, and I promise I’ll try my best not to let that happen again.
translation: 所以，我真的为自己的行为道歉，也保证会尽力不让这种事再次发生。

source: Eh? Why are you saying sorry, Gramps? Emilia’s the one who should apologize!
translation: 嗯？Gramps，你为什么要道歉？应该道歉的是Emilia！

source: Yeah! I still haven’t heard one word of apology from her!
translation: 是啊！我到现在还没听到她说一句道歉！

source: I don’t think ‘sorry’ is even in her vocabulary.
translation: 我觉得“对不起”甚至不在她的词汇里。

source: And besides Gramps, you did everything you could to deflect in the nicest way possible, but she wouldn’t give it up…
translation: 再说了，Gramps，你已经尽可能用最友善的方式化解矛盾，但她就是不肯罢休……

source: There was really no other way it could’ve gone down if you ask me…
translation: 依我看，事情最后也只能这样收场……

source: You were the only one brave enough to stand up to her, sir.
translation: 先生，你是唯一一个有勇气站出来面对她的人。

source: Especially after she attacked Yuri and Yoshi.
translation: 尤其是在她攻击Yuri和Yoshi之后。

source: Yeah… She made everything way too personal… I didn’t even know half the stuff she was referring to, since I’m still new…
translation: 是啊……她把一切都说得太针对个人了……我甚至不知道她指的有一半事情，因为我还是新人……

source: Honestly, my personal history isn’t something I like to talk about… It’s a really sensitive topic for me.
translation: 老实说，我的个人经历不是我喜欢谈论的事……对我来说，这是非常敏感的话题。

source: Sheesh… Using that was a real low blow.
translation: 真是的……拿那种事来攻击人，真够下作。

source: You’re right, but it’s even worse that I did the same… I truly regret it…
translation: 你说得对，但我做了同样的事，情况更糟……我真的很后悔……

source: Some of you aren’t familiar with the anger issues I had in the past..
translation: 你们有些人不了解我过去的易怒问题。

source: I had hoped to put all of those toxic traits behind me after the last summer.
translation: 去年夏天之后，我原本希望能把那些有毒的特质都抛在身后。

source: I’ll do my best to not let them resurface again, and I sincerely hope my actions don’t change the way you see me, as both your leader and your friend.
translation: 我会尽力不让它们再次出现，也真心希望我的行为不会改变你们看待我的方式，无论是作为你们的领袖还是朋友。

source: No way, Gramps! For the bajillionth time, we totally getcha!
translation: 才不会，Gramps！我都说了无数遍了，我们完全理解你！

source: Yeah, sir… If anything, it made us appreciate you even more.
translation: 是的，先生……如果说有什么变化，那就是我们更欣赏你了。

source: Respect.
translation: 尊敬。

source: I’m happy I can say that I understand you much better now, sir…
translation: 我很高兴能说我现在更了解你了，先生……

source: And we accept you for who you are – even the flaws you’re not proud of, Dad!
translation: 我们接受真实的你——包括那些你并不引以为傲的缺点，爸爸！

source: All of us look up to you, and we’re just happy you’re alright now.
translation: 我们所有人都仰望你，只要你现在没事，我们就很高兴。

source: Despite how I acted… Thank you all for keeping an open mind…
translation: 尽管我做了那样的事……谢谢你们愿意保持开放的心态……

source: Either way, Gramps. We’re just glad you’re really okay now.
translation: 不管怎样，Gramps。我们很高兴你真的没事了。

source: Well, I have Yoshinori to thank for that. He helped to calm me down and brought me back to my senses.
translation: 这要感谢Yoshinori。他帮我冷静下来，让我恢复了理智。

source: I-It was really nothing, hehe…
translation: 这、真的没什么，嘿嘿……

source: If you hadn’t done that, we might’ve seen Gramps vs Emilia round two in the lobby this morning, hehe!
translation: 要是你没那么做，我们今天早上可能就会在大厅看到“Gramps大战Emilia”第二回合了，嘿嘿！

source: A-Aiden…
translation: 艾、Aiden……

source: *ehem* Actually, since we’re on this topic… I think we should figure out how to address Emilia from hereon.
translation: *呃咳* 既然说到这个……我觉得我们应该想想接下来该如何处理Emilia。

source: You’re right, Goro… There’s no denying that she’s been causing us major problems in and out of the workplace…
translation: 你说得对，Goro……不可否认，她一直在工作内外给我们制造大麻烦……

source: Just like Sir Goro said last night. Kick her out.
translation: 正如Goro先生昨晚说的。把她赶出去。

source: So, we’re really gonna give her the boot, huh…?
translation: 所以，我们真的要把她赶走，对吧……？

source: Hmmm… right now, while I do feel like that’s the correct choice, I fear that’s a big decision to jump straight to.
translation: 嗯……就现在而言，虽然我也觉得这是正确选择，但我担心我们直接做出这个决定太草率。

source: After all, last night is still fresh on our minds, and we should make that choice with clearer heads.
translation: 毕竟昨晚的事还历历在目，我们应该在头脑更清醒时做出选择。

source: A-Also, even if we wanted to, can we even do that…? She was put in that position by Mr. Clermont himself…
translation: 另、另外，就算我们想这么做，我们真的能做到吗……？她可是Clermont先生亲自安排在这个位置上的……

source: We can’t just continue working with someone that keeps dragging us down either. Besides, Mr. Clermont mentioned replacing her on our last meeting too.
translation: 我们也不能继续和一个不断拖累我们的人合作。此外，Clermont先生上次开会时也提过要替换她。

source: Yeah. And on top of that, even though I warned her before we left for the trip, she still went out of her way to insult Sir Goro.
translation: 是啊。而且，尽管我在出发旅行前警告过她，她还是故意侮辱Goro先生。

source: That happened again during last night’s dinner. When everyone started to point out her flaws, she immediately deflected everything at Sir Goro…
translation: 昨晚的晚餐上又发生了同样的事。当大家开始指出她的缺点时，她立刻把一切推到Goro先生身上……

source: Well, we don’t have any of her information in our records other than her scout application.
translation: 嗯，我们的记录里除了她的童子军申请表，没有她的其他资料。

source: And we just assumed that she was credible since she was put here by Mr. Clermont.
translation: 而且因为她是Clermont先生安排来的，我们就默认她值得信任。

source: There’s no way that Emilia could have maintained her lifestyle without her family’s wealth…
translation: Emilia不可能没有家里的财富还维持得起那种生活……

source: I understand that what we just uncovered solidifies her removal from the project, but… you’ve seen how things turn out if we let ourselves get carried away.
translation: 我明白我们刚刚发现的事已经足以让她离开项目，但……你也看到了，如果我们任由自己被情绪带着走，结果会变成什么样。

source: Goro’s right. And like I said, we have to at least hear Emilia’s side before we make any decisions.
translation: Goro说得对。而且正如我所说，在做决定前，我们至少要听听Emilia的说法。

source: I know we all feel duped, but we should let Yoshi talk to her.
translation: 我知道我们都觉得自己被骗了，但我们应该让Yoshi和她谈谈。

source: Yes… Yoshinori knows what he’s doing…
translation: 是的……Yoshinori知道自己在做什么……

source: Ah…! Yoshinori, you’re back.
translation: 啊……！Yoshinori，你回来了。

source: How did it go?
translation: 进展如何？

source: A-Ah, Goro…
translation: 啊、Goro……

source: Just as I expected…
translation: 和我预料的一样……

source: Everyone else was a bit worried how she’d react towards you.
translation: 其他人有点担心她会怎么对你。

source: From how things escalated yesterday between her and I, I can only imagine how she’d lash out after being confronted with something so serious.
translation: 从昨天她和我之间的事不断升级来看，我只能想象，在面对这么严重的事情时，她会如何发作。

source: As complicated as it is, perhaps it needed to happen for us to understand her actions.
translation: 虽然事情很复杂，但也许只有发生这些，我们才能理解她的行为。

source: I mean… It doesn’t make sense that she would go out of her way to put herself in such trouble without a motive.
translation: 我的意思是……如果没有动机，我实在无法理解她为什么要故意让自己陷入这么大的麻烦。

source: But that’s not your fault, Yoshinori. People naturally drift apart, even from those closest to them.
translation: 但这不是你的错，Yoshinori。人总会自然地渐行渐远，即使是对自己最亲近的人也一样。

source: Just look at my marriage, or even how we were separated. It takes maturity to realize that such things happen.
translation: 看看我的婚姻，或者我们当初是如何分开的就知道了。意识到这种事会发生，需要成熟。

source: You’re very kind, Yoshinori… Possibly too kind.
translation: 你真是善良，Yoshinori……也许善良过头了。

source: That’s a gift you’ve always had, Yoshinori.
translation: 这是你一直拥有的天赋，Yoshinori。

source: But you’ve done what you can for her now. It’s her turn to realize that talking to her means that you care.
translation: 但你现在已经为她做了能做的一切。接下来轮到她意识到，愿意和她交谈就代表你在乎她。

source: You’re right, Goro.
translation: 你说得对，Goro。

source: And on the bright side, at least I understand her better now. I just hope I get the chance to talk to her when we get back to camp...
translation: 好的一面是，至少我现在更了解她了。我只希望回到营地后，还有机会和她谈谈……

source: Now, let’s get some rest. It’s been a long day today.
translation: 现在，我们休息一下吧。今天已经很漫长了。

source: Right…! Good night, Goro.
translation: 对……！晚安，Goro。
